mode.name: Header Buttons
mode.hint: Show sheet header buttons as a ribbon, or collapse them into a dropdown. Right-clicking the sheet always opens the menu (shift + right-click for the browser menu).

picker.name: Menu Macros
picker.label: Choose Macros
picker.menuHint: Pick macros to add to the right-click sheet menu and the item row section.
picker.hint: Sheet menu: where the macro shows in the right-click sheet menu. Item rows: also show it when right-clicking an item on an actor sheet. Macros run as macro({ app, document, item, actor, token }).
picker.empty: No world macros you can run.
picker.otherHint: Comma separated uuids for compendium macros. Prefix with actor: or item: to limit to that sheet type.
